question: A 61-year-old man sustains an intracranial injury to a nerve that also passes through the parotid gland. Which of the following is a possible consequence of this injury?

options.opa: Loss of taste from posterior 1/3 of tongue
options.opb: Loss of general sensation in anterior 2/3 of tongue

analysis: The nerve that passes through the parotid gland is the facial nerve (CN VII). Damage to this nerve can result in various consequences, including loss of taste from the anterior 2/3 of the tongue due to involvement of the chorda tympani branch. Therefore, the correct answer is loss of taste from the anterior 2/3 of the tongue.
